covenant.quote: 7.16. Minimum Unsecured Interest Coverage Ratio. So long as there exists any Outstanding Amounts, the Company will not permit the Unsecured Interest Coverage Ratio for any Test Period to be less than (a) 1.75:1.00, if the Leverage Ratio as of such date is less than 7.00:1.00 and (b) 1.50:1.00, if the Leverage Ratio as of such date is equal to or greater than 7.00:1.00.

thresholds.quote: (a) 1.75:1.00, if the Leverage Ratio as of such date is less than 7.00:1.00

alt_thresholds.quote: (b) 1.50:1.00, if the Leverage Ratio as of such date is equal to or greater than 7.00:1.00.

ratio_definition.quote: "Unsecured Interest Coverage Ratio" means, for any period, the ratio of (a) Unencumbered Consolidated EBITDA for such period to (b) Unsecured Consolidated Interest Expense for such period.

covenant.quote: 7.17. Minimum Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio. So long as there exists any Outstanding Amounts, the Company will not permit the Consolidated Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio for any Test Period to be less than 1.25:1.00.

thresholds.quote: 7.17. Minimum Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio. So long as there exists any Outstanding Amounts, the Company will not permit the Consolidated Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio for any Test Period to be less than 1.25:1.00.

ratio_definition.quote: "Consolidated Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio" means, for any period, the ratio of (a) Consolidated EBITDA for such period, less the sum for such period of (i) 5% of Gross Revenues received from Hotel Properties and (ii) 3% of Gross Revenues received from all other real estate to (b) Consolidated Fixed Charges for such period.

covenant.quote: (b) Unencumbered Assets. The Company will maintain at all times Total Unencumbered Assets of not less than 150% of the aggregate outstanding amount of the Unsecured Indebtedness

thresholds.quote: Total Unencumbered Assets of not less than 150% of the aggregate outstanding amount of the Unsecured Indebtedness

amendments_considered.what_changed: First Amendment (Jun 28, 2024; redline conformed copy): CDOR replaced by Term CORRA; Sections 7.15-7.17 and covenant definitions unchanged.
Second Amendment (Sep 15, 2025; redline conformed copy): Sections 7.15-7.17 text and covenant definitions unchanged.

draft_notes: Financial Covenants (7.15-7.17) apply only 'So long as there exists any Outstanding Amounts' (springing on usage); Section 8.01(b) confirms no compliance needed with no Outstanding Amounts. Recorded as maintenance covenants.

Leverage test is 'at any time' but the ratio uses Consolidated EBITDA for the Test Period then last ended -> test_period ttm. effective_from 2023-03-31 assumed = first quarter-end after the Jan 4, 2023 agreement.
Unsecured Interest Coverage has a leverage-dependent level: 1.75x if Leverage Ratio < 7.00x, 1.50x if >= 7.00x. Base recorded as 1.75 with 'condition'; 1.50 in 'alt_thresholds'.

FCCR numerator is Consolidated EBITDA LESS 5% of Hotel Property Gross Revenues and 3% of other real estate Gross Revenues; numerator_label set to 'Consolidated EBITDA' and the reserve deduction recorded on the ratio term.

Section 7.18(b) Unencumbered Assets test (>=150% of Unsecured Indebtedness, at all times) labeled as kind 'other'; its terms are defined in the Governing Senior Note Indenture (not this exhibit), so no terms[] entries for it. Verifier may prefer to drop it.
